title: Detection uses Item metadata not snippet text
description:
As a scanner engineer, I want detection to use Item metadata (repository, commit, file, lines), so that snippet text is for humans and is not scanned in isolation.

Feature: Detection identity is metadata

  Scenario: Snippet text is not the scan input
    Given a gold Item whose text snippet would not match if regexed alone
    And a scanner finding that overlaps the Item file and lines
    When the detector Score predicts
    Then the result is Yes

  Scenario: Wrong file is not a hit
    Given a gold Item for file src/a.ts lines 10-12
    And a scanner finding on src/b.ts with overlapping line numbers
    When the detector Score predicts
    Then the result is No

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Score uses Item metadata filePath/startLine/endLine, not snippet text.
